stories.headline: Edmonton Elks win a 15th Grey Cup
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks beat the Montreal Alouettes 37–30 to take the Canadian Football League title. It was their 15th Grey Cup and their first since 2015. The game was played at McMahon Stadium in Calgary, the sixth time the city has hosted the final.

stories.headline: An outage hits Apple Pay, iCloud and the App Store
stories.summary: Several Apple services stopped working, among them Apple Pay, iCloud, the App Store and AppleCare. A spokesperson for the company put the problems down to an internal update. The same spokesperson ruled out a cyberattack.

stories.headline: UniCredit's takeover wins approval in Europe and the US
stories.summary: The European Commission and the United States Federal Reserve approved the Italian bank UniCredit's proposed €45 billion acquisition of Germany's Commerzbank. The European Central Bank had given its approval in October. The Commission granted the deal unconditional antitrust clearance.

stories.headline: Hera sends back a new side of an asteroid
stories.summary: The Hera spacecraft has returned an image of the asteroid Didymos from a side that scientists had not previously seen in such detail. It was taken from a distance of 60 km with a camera that works in black and white. Didymos has a diameter of 780 m, and its smaller companion Dimorphos, struck by NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022, measures 151 m across.

sources.excerpt: In Canadian football, the Edmonton Elks win their 15th Canadian Football League title after beating the Montreal Alouettes 37–30 in the Grey Cup. They previously won in 2015.
The game was played on November 15, 2026, at McMahon Stadium in Calgary, Alberta. It was the sixth time that Calgary hosted the Grey Cup, with the previous being in 2019.
The West Division champion Edmonton Elks defeated the East Division champion Montreal Alouettes 37–30 to win their first Grey Cup since 2015.

American technology company Apple experiences an outage with several of its services, including Apple Pay, iCloud, the App Store, and AppleCare. The company's spokesperson attributed the problems to an internal update and rules out a cyberattack.

The European Commission (EC) and the United States Federal Reserve approve Italian bank UniCredit's proposed €45 billion (US$49 billion) acquisition of Germany's Commerzbank, following the European Central Bank's approval in October.
The EC grants unconditional antitrust clearance.

On September 26, 2022, NASA's DART spacecraft deliberately crashed into Dimorphos, the smaller of the two asteroids in the system. Hera's latest image provides a look at its larger companion, Didymos, from a side that scientists had not previously seen in such detail.
The image was taken from a distance of 60 km using Hera's monochromatic Asteroid Framing Camera, which captures images in black and white.
Although most of Dimorphos, which measures 151 m across, is concealed in shadow, the much larger Didymos, with a diameter of 780 m, is clearly visible.
